records.text: Frank Turek said he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law when the shot rang out, put the phone in his pocket, and found them still connected when he reached the hospital.
records.speaker: Frank Turek

appearances.snippet: i was facetiming my son and daughter-in-law when the shot rang out i put the phone in my pocket not even remembering they were there because as soon as charlie shot i'm heading toward him and then running with him i just put it in my back pocket they heard the entire thing until we got to the hospital when i pulled it out of my pocket they were still there

verification.notes: Frank Turek has publicly repeated that he was FaceTiming his son Spencer and daughter-in-law when the shot was fired, put the phone in his back pocket, and ended the call after arriving at the hospital. His July 2026 response explicitly says hotel was a prior misspeak and hospital was the intended location.

records.text: In another interview, Frank Turek said he pulled the phone from his pocket at a hotel and his son and daughter-in-law were still connected.
records.speaker: Frank Turek

appearances.snippet: Yeah, he it was my son and daughter in law. ... turn it off i just you know instinctively and uh by the time i got to a hotel i pulled it out they were still there so they heard the whole thing

verification.notes: The earlier interview clip records Turek saying hotel. In a later July 2026 interview, Turek directly acknowledged using the word hotel and said it was a misspeak for hospital because the hotel was reached many hours later. The statement accurately reports the earlier utterance, with the correction preserved in the note.
